cohort: Women with a previous cesarean section
finding: While anterior placental location showed a trend towards increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage in women with a previous cesarean section, the association was not statistically significant; however, placenta previa was associated with a high risk of both postpartum hemorrhage and retained placenta in this population.
mod_finding: Women with a previous cesarean section have a high overall risk of postpartum hemorrhage and retained placenta.
